name: elfsworn_giant_only_your_lands
notes: M5 mapper. Printed: 'Landfall — Whenever a land you control enters, create a 1/1 green Elf Warrior creature token.' On seat 1's turn seat 1 plays a Swamp: not seat 0's land, no token. On seat 0's next turn seat 0 plays a Forest: exactly one 1/1 Elf Warrior.
